name: Airworthiness+

tokens.name: background-100
tokens.usage: Geist Background 1. The default background for the page and every element. The go-to.

tokens.name: background-200
tokens.usage: Geist Background 2. Secondary background, used sparingly: the sidebar and table header rows.

tokens.name: gray-100
tokens.usage: Hover background on Background 1, and the filter group track.

tokens.name: gray-200
tokens.usage: Active background on Background 1.

tokens.name: gray-400
tokens.usage: Divider: decorative lines between rows and sections only. Below 3:1, so never the edge of a control (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11); controls use control-border.

tokens.name: gray-500
tokens.usage: Hover border.

tokens.name: gray-900
tokens.usage: Secondary text and icons: the line under a title, table headers, labels above values.

tokens.name: gray-1000
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, and the primary button fill. Almost all text.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: The edge of every input, select, text area and secondary button: 3:1 or more on every background (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The focus outline, focus-width wide at focus-offset from the element: 3:1 or more in both themes (SC 2.4.7, 2.4.11).

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Round status dot in a Status column only.

tokens.name: status-due
tokens.usage: Round status dot for due soon, deferred or waiting.

tokens.name: status-stop
tokens.usage: Round status dot for unserviceable, overdue or quarantined.

tokens.name: status-ok-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of the green status dot, so the dot reaches 3:1 on every background (SC 1.4.11). The word beside it still carries the meaning.

tokens.name: status-due-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of the amber status dot (SC 1.4.11).

tokens.name: status-stop-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of the red status dot (SC 1.4.11).

styles.name: heading-24
styles.usage: The one page title. Never larger inside the app.

styles.name: heading-16
styles.usage: Section headings, like Usage and Projects on the Vercel dashboard.

styles.name: heading-14
styles.usage: A heading inside a section, sparingly.

styles.name: label-14
styles.usage: The most common style: table values, menus, sidebar items, tabs. Strong (500) for the first column, titles of list rows and fact values.

styles.name: label-13
styles.usage: A secondary line beside or under other labels, in gray-900. Tabular figures for numbers.

styles.name: copy-14
styles.sample: Deferred by the pilot-in-command on 3 November.

styles.name: copy-13
styles.usage: Secondary text where space is limited, in gray-900.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a value and the meta line under it.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons, and between a status square and its word.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a section title and its content.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, sideways and summary strip padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page padding at the top, and the page padding at the sides is space-10.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between sections, and page padding at the sides.

tokens.name: material-base
tokens.usage: Geist material base, for everyday surfaces: tables, cards, fact panels, buttons, inputs, sidebar items.

tokens.name: material-medium
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces and menus.

tokens.name: material-fullscreen
tokens.usage: Fullscreen overlays only.

tokens.name: status-dot
tokens.usage: The round 10px status dot.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: The only line width. Every divider, table border and control border.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Width of the focus outline and the error summary edge.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between an element and its focus outline.

source: Geist design system by Vercel: vercel.com/geist. Roles and usage follow the published Typography, Colors and Materials pages. Pixel values follow the Geist Tailwind preset.

display.settings: design-system/Accessibility.md, Display Settings. Each value is the default; a setting written on <html> replaces it.

tokens.name: text-scale
tokens.usage: Multiplies every font size and line height. Text Size: Default, Large, Larger.

tokens.name: target-minimum
tokens.usage: The smallest pointer target (SC 2.5.8; SC 2.5.5 in Comfortable).

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: row-padding
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a table cell.

tokens.name: motion
tokens.usage: Length of the one transition, the turn of a disclosure chevron. 0ms under Reduce Motion (SC 2.3.3).
